svg.text: One frame per mode, canopy, Nsight Systems capture N1 (Perfect Presentation off), drawn from the report's data
Left: one frame, from its SwapBuffers call until the GPU has done its work (the GPU runs behind the CPU). Right: zoomed in on the Bridge's GPU work.
CPU = the render thread; GPU = OpenGL work on the GPU. DirectX work isn't traced: it shows as the hatched gap in the OpenGL queue.

GL queue waits while DLSS runs on DirectX: 1.035 ms

svg.text: Times in ms from the frame's SwapBuffers call. Under Nsight the CPU side runs slower than without it (frame periods 11-19 ms against 4-7 ms in P1-P3); GPU durations come from GPU timestamps.
